basis: Manual provisional editorial annotations after visual inspection of the actual local reproduction. Visual energy is compositional activity; complexity is visible density; humanity is depicted human salience; narrative is depicted action; atmosphere is emphasis on depicted setting; color is colour intensity. These are not psychometric measurements or reported emotions.

add-varo-harmony.alt: An elongated seated figure works at a musical stave in a room where walls open around other figures.
add-varo-harmony.note: A carefully built interior combines a desk, music, floating forms and figures emerging from the walls.

add-varo-sympathy.alt: A seated person touches an orange cat on a red table as fine radiating lines cross the room.
add-varo-sympathy.note: The connection between the hand, cat and room is drawn with a web of fine intersecting lines.

add-varo-icon.alt: A pointed gold-edged panel shows a central doorway among moons, stars, hands and a plant-like form.
add-varo-icon.note: This is the open state of one hinged work; its closed state is not counted as a second artwork.

add-varo-weaving-space-time.alt: Two long-robed figures meet in a lit chamber surrounded by overlapping strands and dark weaving.
add-varo-weaving-space-time.note: A bright room and its figures appear enclosed within a much darker network of fine lines.

add-gerzso-water-mansion.alt: Layered olive-green planes overlap horizontally, with dark narrow gaps and several angular notches.
add-gerzso-water-mansion.note: Muted flat surfaces and small recesses supply structure without depicting a literal setting.

add-gerzso-yellow-green-blue.alt: A broad pale-blue rectangle overlaps yellow, green, red and smaller blue planes bounded by dark lines.
add-gerzso-yellow-green-blue.note: Large geometric colour fields dominate this painting, with smaller blocks clustered near the edges.

add-gerzso-landscape-red-ii.alt: Dark red vertical planes hover above a large pale-blue angular field with a small yellow square.
add-gerzso-landscape-red-ii.note: The institution identifies this object as a print on paper. The title does not make it a depicted landscape.

add-izquierdo-sorrowful-friday.alt: A solemn framed female face rises above fruit, flowers, candles, vessels and bright draped fabric.
add-izquierdo-sorrowful-friday.note: A frontal face is surrounded by a dense arrangement of devotional and domestic objects.

add-izquierdo-idyll.alt: A small pale figure and a curved red object occupy a narrow landscape between tall bare trees.
add-izquierdo-idyll.note: The tree-lined space places a small figure inside a much larger and visibly constructed landscape.

add-izquierdo-living-still-life.alt: Fruit, cups and a dark bottle sit on a table opening onto reddish walls and a hilly landscape.
add-izquierdo-living-still-life.note: A still-life foreground shares the painting with an outdoor setting beyond the table.

add-tamayo-still-life-foot.alt: A large boot, playing cards, scissors and a small dark framed form sit against brown and grey planes.
add-tamayo-still-life-foot.note: A few familiar objects are isolated and simplified; there is no depicted human figure.

add-tamayo-woman-watermelon.alt: A dark seated female figure holds a bright pink slice of watermelon in a textured pink field.
add-tamayo-woman-watermelon.note: The figure and fruit are large, while the surrounding space offers few setting details.

add-atl-popocatepetl.alt: Snowy volcanoes rise above dark trees and dry mountain slopes beneath a bright blue sky.
add-atl-popocatepetl.note: The volcano and surrounding terrain carry the composition without any prominent human figure.

add-atl-climatic-eruption.alt: Red lava and a high orange eruption illuminate a dark volcanic cone beneath blue and grey clouds.
add-atl-climatic-eruption.note: An active eruption offers a high-activity landscape comparison with the stiller volcano view.

add-rivera-zapatista-landscape.alt: Overlapping angular forms suggest a sombrero, rifle and woven cloth against pale mountain-like planes.
add-rivera-zapatista-landscape.note: Rivera painted this Cubist work in Paris in 1915; it is not a Mexican outdoor scene recorded from life.
add-rivera-zapatista-landscape.title: Zapatista Landscape (The Guerrilla)

add-rivera-portrait-frida.alt: A frontal close portrait of Frida Kahlo fills a narrow field with yellow earrings and a dark shawl.
add-rivera-portrait-frida.note: A large face and few surrounding objects provide a figurative comparison with little depicted setting.

add-rivera-flower-vendor.alt: A standing flower seller in pale green carries large orange blossoms; a smaller figure sits to the right.
add-rivera-flower-vendor.note: The source records charcoal and gouache on paper; large flowers and the standing figure dominate.

add-orozco-buffoons.alt: A crowded group of gesturing, hat-wearing figures is built from loose black lines on a light ground.
add-orozco-buffoons.note: This nearly monochrome composition emphasizes grouped figures and vigorous marks rather than a setting.

add-siqueiros-madre-nina.alt: A standing woman carries a child high on her back, both rendered in dense dark and pale marks.
add-siqueiros-madre-nina.note: The source identifies artist and date but does not specify the medium; it remains unknown here.

add-carrington-dagobert.alt: Many small robed figures, animals, fires and strange vessels occupy connected chambers and landscapes.
add-carrington-dagobert.note: The painting contains several simultaneous scenes instead of one isolated focal action.

add-merida-time-space.alt: A tall arrangement of cream, red, black and yellow triangles, rectangles and divided circles interlocks.
add-merida-time-space.note: The source records lacquer on wood; geometric motifs form the whole image rather than an outdoor scene.

add-merida-untitled-1950.alt: Repeated black and cream angular forms suggest a vertical dance on an irregular tan paper sheet.
add-merida-untitled-1950.note: Ink and gouache are applied to amate paper; repeated forms are visually legible without assigning them a narrative.

add-paalen-golden-fleece.alt: A large moth-like form rests above a pale head and patterned dark pedestal against a blue sky.
add-paalen-golden-fleece.note: Recognizable fragments are combined into a single impossible upright form.

add-kahlo-girl-death-mask.alt: A small child in pink wears a skull mask and holds a flower beside a second mask on the ground.
add-kahlo-girl-death-mask.note: A single masked child is clearly separated from a sparse grassy ground and cloudy sky.

add-kahlo-borderline.alt: Frida Kahlo in a pink dress stands between ancient Mexican forms and US factories, pipes and machines.
add-kahlo-borderline.note: The painted environment is divided between distinct groups of architecture, plants and industrial objects.

add-mondrian-composition-1930.alt: A large red square and smaller white, blue and yellow rectangles are separated by thick black lines.
add-mondrian-composition-1930.note: This 1930 work is a different object from the 1927 Mondrian already in the collection.

add-mondrian-composition-ten.alt: A dense oval field of small black horizontal and vertical strokes floats on a pale background.
add-mondrian-composition-ten.note: Its many short marks provide a dense monochrome alternative to Mondrian's broad colour blocks.

add-mondrian-composition-colour-a.alt: Separated red, blue, ochre and black rectangles sit across a large white field.
add-mondrian-composition-colour-a.note: Small disconnected colour blocks leave much of the surface open.

add-mondrian-tableau-one.alt: Many small grey, ochre and pale rectangles interlock within thin dark angular outlines.
add-mondrian-tableau-one.note: A crowded network of subdued planes supplies a comparison with the artist's later sparse geometry.

add-kandinsky-composition-seven.alt: Sweeping curves, diagonals and irregular colour patches crowd almost the entire horizontal surface.
add-kandinsky-composition-seven.note: A dense field of varied marks supplies activity without a clearly depicted scene or human figure.

add-kandinsky-impression-concert.alt: A large black mass sits in a vivid yellow field with loose blue, red and pale forms nearby.
add-kandinsky-impression-concert.note: The black shape and yellow field dominate; the title's concert reference is contextual information, not a visible preference score.

add-kandinsky-rowing.alt: Thick black diagonals and curved lines cross loose yellow, blue, green and violet washes.
add-kandinsky-rowing.note: The flowing marks and diagonals make a less densely packed counterpart to CompositionVII.

add-kandinsky-circle-square.alt: Black patterned circles, triangles and curved forms occupy a muted pink horizontal field.
add-kandinsky-circle-square.note: The work uses bounded patterned forms rather than the loose overlapping marks of the earlier Kandinskys.

add-kupka-cathedral.alt: Tall blue and black angular bands meet lower red and pale planes in a dense faceted arrangement.
add-kupka-cathedral.note: The architectural title can be explored as context; visible facets and colour are annotated separately.

add-af-klint-dove-two.alt: Large pink, violet and pale circular shapes overlap within a tall field divided into red and dark areas.
add-af-klint-dove-two.note: A few broad intersecting curves provide a sparse abstract comparison with more densely marked work.

add-af-klint-untitled-1933.alt: A pale female head in profile appears against pink, red and grey rays and flowing marks.
add-af-klint-untitled-1933.note: This source image is figurative despite its artist's association with abstraction; human presence is annotated accordingly.

add-klee-wald-bau.alt: A dense patchwork of green, turquoise and orange angular shapes includes fine tree-like dark lines.
add-klee-wald-bau.note: Geometric patches and finer organic marks share a tightly filled surface.

add-klee-flowering-tree.alt: Small coloured squares form a loose central cluster against a grid of larger dark green and brown squares.
add-klee-flowering-tree.note: Colour changes within repeated small units provide a stiller geometric comparison.

add-klee-rose-garden.alt: Red and purple geometric planes, small circular flowers and blocky buildings fill a compact space.
add-klee-rose-garden.note: The garden is stylized into repeated circles and interlocking planes with some recognizable building forms.

add-albers-light-grey-wall.alt: Nested black, grey and white horizontal rectangles form a symmetrical open doorway-like pattern.
add-albers-light-grey-wall.note: Large repeated rectangular boundaries create structure with almost no hue variation.

add-malevich-football-player.alt: A large tilted purple quadrilateral and smaller red, yellow, blue and black shapes sit on a white canvas.
add-malevich-football-player.note: The title names a football player, but the composition does not visibly depict a human body.
caveats: Institution reproduction includes the canvas edge, slight perspective and a narrow neutral surround.

add-delaunay-air-iron-water.alt: Overlapping bright circular forms and curved bands surround an angular tower-like central structure.
add-delaunay-air-iron-water.note: Curved colour forms and a central architectural suggestion share a densely occupied surface.

add-ernst-divinite.alt: A towering red-brown textured figure with a beaked head rises amid smaller dark rocky forms.
add-ernst-divinite.note: A figure-like form emerges from textured marks; a precise identity or story is not assumed from appearance.

add-rothko-orange-yellow.alt: A soft-edged yellow rectangle floats above a broad orange field within a warmer orange border.
add-rothko-orange-yellow.note: Two large colour areas occupy almost the whole surface without depicting objects or a setting.

add-pollock-convergence.alt: A dense web of black, white, yellow, red and blue drips and sweeping lines fills a wide surface.
add-pollock-convergence.note: The image supplies dense visual activity without a depicted narrative or prominent human figure.
caveats: Institution reproduction includes a thin visible frame.

add-thomas-etude-blue.alt: Thick blue and dark strokes interweave over a pale field with a few small warm-coloured marks.
add-thomas-etude-blue.note: Broad overlapping painted marks provide another energetic abstraction with a more restricted palette.

add-magritte-fanatiques.alt: A dark bird flies over a bright orange fire burning in a rocky landscape beneath a heavy grey sky.
add-magritte-fanatiques.note: A clearly rendered landscape contains an unusual arrangement of bird and fire; ambiguity is not coded as abstractness.

add-miro-composition-1933.alt: Large black, white and red curved forms float across blue, green and brown fields.
add-miro-composition-1933.note: A few broad, separated forms supply a less crowded comparison with Miró's Carnival of Harlequin.
caveats: Institution reproduction includes a thin visible frame.

add-miro-harlequin-carnival.alt: Numerous small hybrid figures, instruments, curved lines and coloured shapes fill a pale pink interior.
add-miro-harlequin-carnival.note: The image contains many simultaneous figure-like activities; the room remains partly visible behind them.

add-de-chirico-engineer.alt: Boards, frames and a patterned upright object overlap within a sharply angled yellow and green interior.
add-de-chirico-engineer.note: Recognizable constructed objects are juxtaposed in an enclosed, fractured space without a human figure.

add-hammershoi-room-wife.alt: A small seated woman in dark clothing faces away in a pale grey room lit through a tall curtained window.
add-hammershoi-room-wife.note: A human figure remains small while walls, doors and window light occupy most of the composition.

add-morandi-still-life-1948.alt: A small cluster of grey, brown and cream bottles, jars and vases stands on a plain pale ground.
add-morandi-still-life-1948.note: A few repeated everyday objects provide a sparse representational comparison with the geometric abstractions.

add-watts-hope.alt: A blindfolded seated woman bends over a lyre while resting on a large globe against a muted blue field.
add-watts-hope.note: This is Tate's 1886 version, attributed to George Frederic Watts and assistants, not the earlier version.

add-krasner-icarus.alt: Orange, pink, dark red and cream looping marks and irregular shapes overlap densely across a wide surface.
add-krasner-icarus.note: The complete reproduction retains the painting's densely worked surface; no figure or story is assumed from its title.

add-dali-transparent-simulacrum.alt: A pale cloth-like form floats before an empty yellow plain, distant rocks and a dark cliff with a face at its edge.
add-dali-transparent-simulacrum.note: Smoothly rendered objects can also be read as landscape forms; the image does not prescribe one interpretation.

add-herrera-cobalt-white.alt: Two tall cobalt-blue planes are divided by a tapering white wedge with narrow white strips at the edges.
add-herrera-cobalt-white.note: A very small number of sharply bounded forms gives a vivid but sparse abstract comparison.

add-newman-prometheus-bound.alt: A tall near-black painted field has subtle dark tonal variations and a narrow rough white band along the bottom.
add-newman-prometheus-bound.note: A nearly monochrome surface supplies a low-density abstract comparison. The primary reproduction is limited to 400×1056 pixels.
caveats: Primary institution source is400×1056 pixels; no artificial enlargement was applied.
